overview: Electricity Loss Segmentation Analytics addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in power and utilities operations. The first proof of value uses feeder energy input, smart meter output and asset maps. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is technical versus non-technical loss variance, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: feeder energy input, smart meter output and asset maps; define technical versus non-technical loss variance and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Grid Operations Director / Chief Asset Officer.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
